arithmetic.method: Independent exact-rational reconstruction of 365-day product/store shares with 20 pseudo-units per pair, prior full-year monthly factors, 56-day network level, daily stock/receipt timing and order constraints.
arithmetic.limits: Chosen-scenario arithmetic only; no complete-demand, model-superiority, frozen-holdout or authenticated verifier gate acceptance.

manual_response_review.current_process: Exact supplied answer describes using last month sales for the week. Day-count scaling is a reasonable interpretation; response explicitly says exact buying rules unavailable.
manual_response_review.comparison: About 9% gain is explicitly qualified as errors giving more weight to large misses, consistent with RMSE; no claim that all metrics or all alternatives improve. Simple year-long average acknowledged almost as accurate.
manual_response_review.local_cost: Actual generated calculation uses local Python/pandas/numpy with about 5 MB sources and a short measured runtime. Ordinary computer/no paid routine model calls is supported. Electricity/computer costs acknowledged, separate AI build price unknown.
manual_response_review.scope: No full frozen December holdout, authenticated verifier/parent gate or milestone acceptance granted.
